The Persian Declaration

The Persian state has failed it's people. Years of bad policies have led the nation to the brink of being wiped off the map, and they have clearly not learned from this experience. We must save it's people from their despotic overlords, and form a new nation in its place.
The Return of the Seleucids
With Persia defeated, we can finally declare a restoration of the ancient Seleucid Empire, a perfect blend of Persian and Greek culture.
The Conquest of Mesopotamia and Roman Syria.

The Empires of Persia have always struggled to retain control over Mesopotamia and Syria. The Parthians clashed with the Romans, the Shiites clashed with the Sunnis, the Persian Empire clashed with the Egyptians. Now the time has come for us to attempt to achieve control over the region, without it we will never be able to contest Anatolia.
The Heirs to Alexander

All our enemies lay defeated. We have overcome impossible odds to defeat the Persians, Turks, Greeks, Egyptians, and Arabs. Through sheer military might and the strength of our people, we have undone the greatest tragedy in all of world history. We are the sons and daughters of Alexander, his soldiers and lieutenants, the farmers, merchants, nobles, lawmakers, and philosophers. We are Macedonians, and we will never again bend our knee!
